title: Older Knowledge Becomes Newly Relevant
body:
Something learned earlier — a skill, a lesson, a piece of inherited insight — is being pulled back toward the surface. The context around you is starting to ask for exactly the kind of knowledge you already hold.
Action: Reopen one piece of past learning or documentation instead of starting from scratch.
notes: Converted from predictive_window_blocks.json. Routes on legacy leading_index.
